column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# POST /api/register with email 'not-an-email' and a valid name/password

*Expected*
422 with an error on 'email'

*Actual*
201 Created, account and token issued

*Code location*
AuthController::register - 'email' rule has no 'email' validator

*Detected by*
* Postman: Register invalid email format
* JUnit: AuthApiTest.registerRejectsInvalidEmail (5 cases)
* Cypress: auth.cy.ts invalid e-mail

*Suggested fix*
Add the 'email' rule to the validator.

column1: [BUG-002] Order quantity not range-checked (0, negative and >1000 accepted)
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# POST /api/orders with items[0].quantity = 0, -5 or 1001

*Expected*
422 (allowed range 1..1000)

*Actual*
201 Created; zero/negative quantities and totals are stored

*Code location*
OrderController::store - quantity rule is 'required|integer' (min/max removed)

*Detected by*
* Postman: Quantity 0 / -5 / 1001
* JUnit: OrderApiTest.invalidQuantity
* Cypress: orders.cy.ts quantity 0
* PL/SQL: QTY_POSITIVE

*Suggested fix*
Restore 'required|integer|min:1|max:1000'. Add a DB CHECK constraint as defence in depth.

column1: [BUG-003] Broken object-level authorization: any user can access any order (IDOR)
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Register users A and B
# A creates an order (id N)
# As B call GET/PUT/DELETE /api/orders/N and POST /api/orders/N/pay

*Expected*
403 Forbidden

*Actual*
200 - B can read, edit, pay, ship, cancel and delete A's order

*Code location*
OrderController::load - ownership check skipped

*Detected by*
* Postman: User B cannot read/update/pay user A order
* JUnit: OrderApiTest.isolationBetweenUsers

*Suggested fix*
Compare order.user_id with the authenticated user (or scope the query / use a policy).

column1: [BUG-004] Order can be paid more than once (double charge)
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Create an order
# POST /pay twice

*Expected*
Second call: 409 Conflict, payment_attempts stays 1

*Actual*
Second call 200, payment_attempts = 2

*Code location*
OrderController::pay - status guard allows 'paid'

*Detected by*
* Postman: Pay again
* JUnit: WorkflowApiTest.cannotPayTwice
* PL/SQL: SINGLE_PAYMENT

*Suggested fix*
Allow payment only from status 'created'; make the transition idempotent / use a DB lock.

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create an order
# POST /ship without paying

*Expected*
409 Conflict

*Actual*
200, status shipped, paid_at is null

*Code location*
OrderController::ship - 'created' accepted as a source status

*Detected by*
* Postman: Ship before pay
* JUnit: WorkflowApiTest.cannotShipUnpaid
* PL/SQL: SHIPPED_WAS_PAID

*Suggested fix*
Ship only from status 'paid'.

column1: [BUG-006] Pagination repeats the last row of the previous page
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Create 5 orders
# GET /api/orders?per_page=2&page=1 then page=2

*Expected*
Pages contain disjoint ids

*Actual*
First row of page 2 equals last row of page 1; the last order is never reachable

*Code location*
OrderController::index - offset reduced by 1 for page > 1

*Detected by*
* Postman: Pagination page 2 overlap
* JUnit: OrderApiTest.paginationHasNoOverlap
* Cypress: orders.cy.ts pagination

*Suggested fix*
offset = (page - 1) * per_page.

column1: [BUG-007] Silent 10% discount on lines with quantity >= 10
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# POST /api/orders with quantity 10, unit_price 100

*Expected*
total = 1000.00

*Actual*
total = 900.00

*Code location*
OrderController::store - total multiplied by 0.9 for qty >= 10

*Detected by*
* Postman: Bulk order no hidden discount
* JUnit: OrderApiTest.noHiddenDiscount
* Cypress: bulk total
* PL/SQL: TOTAL_MATCHES_ITEMS

*Suggested fix*
Remove the undocumented discount (or specify it in the requirements first).

column1: [BUG-008] Login reveals whether an e-mail is registered (user enumeration)
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# POST /api/login with an unregistered e-mail

*Expected*
401 'Invalid credentials' (identical to a wrong password)

*Actual*
404 'No account found for this email'

*Code location*
AuthController::login - separate 404 branch for unknown e-mail

*Detected by*
* Postman: Login unknown email
* JUnit: AuthApiTest.loginDoesNotEnumerateUsers
* Cypress: auth.cy.ts same message

*Suggested fix*
Return the same status and message for both cases (and add rate limiting).

column1: [BUG-009] customer_name longer than 100 chars causes HTTP 500
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# POST /api/orders with a 101-character customer_name

*Expected*
422 validation error

*Actual*
500 Server Error (DB truncation)

*Code location*
OrderController::store - max length rule removed; DB column is VARCHAR(100)

*Detected by*
* Postman: customer_name 101 chars
* JUnit: OrderApiTest.customerNameLength
* Cypress: 101-char name

*Suggested fix*
Validate 'max:100'; never let user input reach the DB unvalidated.

*Steps to reproduce*
# Create, pay and ship an order
# POST /cancel

*Expected*
409 Conflict

*Actual*
200, status cancelled while shipped_at is still set

*Code location*
OrderController::cancel - 'shipped' accepted as a source status

*Detected by*
* Postman: Cancel shipped order
* JUnit: WorkflowApiTest.cannotCancelShipped
* PL/SQL: CANCELLED_NOT_SHIPPED

*Suggested fix*
Cancel only from 'created' or 'paid'.

column1: [BUG-011] Login / register inputs have no accessible labels
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Open the login page
# Run axe-core or inspect with a screen reader

*Expected*
Each field has a programmatically associated label

*Actual*
axe rule 'label' fails; placeholders vanish on input

*Code location*
Login.tsx - placeholder used instead of <label>

*Detected by*
* Cypress: accessibility.cy.ts login page

*Suggested fix*
Add <label htmlFor> elements (and autocomplete attributes).

column1: [BUG-012] Status badge text fails colour-contrast requirement
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Open the orders list
# Measure badge colours or run axe

*Expected*
Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1

*Actual*
Contrast ratio about 2.4:1

*Code location*
styles.css - .badge-lowcontrast (#9aa0a6 on #f5f7fa, about 2.4:1)

*Detected by*
* Cypress: accessibility.cy.ts orders list
* Playwright: axe scan on mobile

*Suggested fix*
Use a darker text colour (e.g. #1f2933).

column1: [BUG-013] Orders table forces horizontal scrolling on small screens
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Open the orders list at 375px width

*Expected*
No horizontal page scroll (content reflows or the table scrolls inside its own container)

*Actual*
The whole page scrolls sideways

*Code location*
OrderList.tsx + styles.css - table min-width 720px without a scroll container

*Detected by*
* Cypress: responsive.cy.ts (4 small viewports)
* Playwright: iPhone / Pixel overflow test

*Suggested fix*
Wrap the table in an overflow-x container and drop the fixed min-width on the page.

column1: [BUG-014] 'Pay' action is a clickable <div>, not a button
column7:
*Steps to reproduce*
# Open a created order
# Try to reach Pay with the Tab key

*Expected*
Pay is focusable and activates with Enter/Space

*Actual*
Pay cannot be focused; keyboard and screen-reader users cannot pay

*Code location*
OrderDetail.tsx - div with onClick

*Detected by*
* Cypress: workflow.cy.ts Pay is a button

*Suggested fix*
Use a <button>.

*Steps to reproduce*
# Submit the login form with wrong credentials

*Expected*
Visible error message announced via role=alert

*Actual*
Nothing happens

*Code location*
Login.tsx - error swallowed in the catch block

*Detected by*
* Cypress: auth.cy.ts wrong credentials
* Playwright: login error on mobile

*Suggested fix*
Render err.message in a role=alert element.
